content: Our Q4 performance reflects steady, disciplined execution. Full-year revenue crossed $396 million, growing 17% YoY, while maintaining industry-leading gross margins of 79.1%. Our proprietary AI anomaly detection modules run locally on client clusters, allowing us to expand analytical value without absorbing third-party GPU cloud costs.

Simon, we've seen competitors in the observability space experience gross margin pressure from LLM inference bills. How has Vortex managed to keep gross margin stable above 79% while rolling out generative telemetry summaries?

Emily, from day one our engineering thesis was edge-first distillation. We avoid unconstrained external LLM API calls on high-frequency log streams. Our customers get instant root-cause analysis, and our unit economics remain highly profitable. We generated $24.2 million in Free Cash Flow this quarter.
